project: Catch 100 samosas and pocket 50 shiny coins!
Survive the madness for 45 seconds to earn 45 coins!

Dodge 10 spicy chillies and grab 
30 coins—no burns!
Tap to power up the magnet! Every click boosts it by 1 second.
Upgrade to a Bigger Tray and increase its width by 10% for 200 coins!
Reach 800 points and unlock Pro Music—play like a pro!

Chilli – Too spicy! Touch it and you lose a life. 
Fire alert!

Spoiled Samosa – This samosa went to the 
dark side… −3 points!

Samosa – Crunchy and happy! +2 points. 
Munch away!

Golden Samosa – The king of snacks! +10 points. 
Respect the shine!

Power-Up Plate – Slows everything for 5 seconds. 
Chill mode ON!

Magnetic Ring – Superpower activated! Pulls 
samosas to your plate for 5 seconds. 
Snack vacuum!
